verdicts.summary: [N] nasqret/z-in-q-lean states a different claim; neither implies the other (differs).
evidence: The pole difference is real: multiplyTemplate reaches ndep's poleTemplate with T1=A(A-e)(A+e), not [M]'s A+3e, so ZOverQ.Qualitative.multiplication_exact is exactness for another polynomial, conditional on UniformHeight m and PoleCompleteness. The guard part of the note overstates: [M]'s cutoff is T=(48A_ht)^13 (tex 1228), so guardCutoff m=(48m)^13 is [M]'s T with A_ht named abstractly (a close-type difference), not a different cutoff.

ZOverQ.Qualitative.multiplication_exact proves MultiplicationExact for ndep's multiplyTemplate at guardCutoff m = (48m)^13, with m an integer above an abstract UniformHeight constant, whereas [M]'s T = (48A_ht)^13 has A_ht fixed; and the template's slope tests call ndep's poleTemplate with T1 = A(A-e)(A+e). So the relation is a different polynomial's, conditional on UniformHeight and PoleCompleteness, as claimed.
